register: Collapse run under the assumed group-assignment rule: front-swap Fisher-Yates readout of the documented Mersenne-twister stream, seed 8675309 (the Technical Notes print the SURVEYSELECT call, seed and group count but not the readout; results that depend on it are conditional on this assumption). Given the assumed rule the group assignment is a function of the input order alone; the four realizations here are the four input-order conventions under that one rule. Each realization's flip set is a point statement conditional on its order convention; the four-order envelope is what remains after the resampled reruns (the order is stated in no Technical Notes edition). Everything else (jobs, membership, vintages, guardrails, arms, aggregation) is identical to the stored docsonly census.
